Communicate

Send a message to donors or members on WhatsApp: an update, a pooja invite, a thank-you. Tap WhatsApp next to a name to open that chat with your message ready.
"Share message + photos" opens your phone's share sheet. Choose a WhatsApp group or broadcast list so everyone gets the photos together. WhatsApp cannot send photos to many people from a web page automatically.

Cash held by team members

Money received by a team member stays with that member until it is handed over to the Admin (Puneeth, SVVGB Fund). Record the hand-over below and the balance moves to the Admin.

Transfer cash

The member receiving the cash must approve the transfer (Approve button in the saved list below). Balances change only after approval.

Photos

All proof photos from contributions, donations, expenses and transfers are collected here. You can also upload more photos (pooja, event, bills). Tap a photo to open it, then Download.

Fund dashboard

Updates by itself from every entry saved by the team.

Saved donations

Entries are kept on this phone only. Send each donation to the coordinator so it is recorded.
Sending the receipt image: WhatsApp cannot open a chat with a file attached from a web page, so its share sheet asks you to pick the chat. The donor's number is copied for you. Paste it in WhatsApp's search box. "Message only" opens the donor's chat directly.
